title: Easy aerobic + Z2 spin after the Chisinau day

steps.target: Z2 bike, 134-147bpm, indoor spin, evening, easy legs

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 07:50-08:40 run, 50min at 138-150bpm, done before the 09:00 block. Evening spin 18:30-19:05, 35min at 134-147bpm bike, cadence 85-95.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water. Dinner by 20:30, carb-forward, no alcohol (Sat long run). Bed by 22:30.
GARMIN: run ~45-60, spin ~25-35.
STOP RULE: under 6h sleep or HRV under 50 = run 30min only, no spin.
WATCH: run only is sent to the watch; spin is a free ride.
WHY: Thursday is a 04:00-to-midnight travel day with zero load; spin adds ~25 load at no leg impact (+25 vs old plan).
